method: Production scripts in Node VM with native Canvas and isolated HTTP/DOM/storage/audio. No physical Android device.

results.name: Reproduce the old name-entry failure: rejected fetch leaves the engine in menu
Rejected fetch: same name form starts a playable local campaign with no raw error
Hanging fetch and missing AbortController: whole start expires at 7 seconds
Manual local entry cancels registration; a late response cannot replace the engine
Late start response and repeated taps never launch a second campaign
HTTP 503 and a non-JSON server response both allow local play
Validation errors stay visible and are not silently converted to guest games
Local resume after reload retains actual progress and resumes paused
Changing to local play preserves unsent ranked outbox and identity byte for byte
Storage denied: local play still starts and reports memory-only progress
Unreadable local save is retained separately before creating a fresh game
Repeated module installation does not add timers, handlers or wrappers
Diagnostics are bounded and contain neither server messages nor identity
Captain extraction preserves PNG bytes and all other core logic
